$comment: The capability register (docs/34-accounting-conformance-spec-V1.md, section 3.2). Every module in section 3.1 must appear. A not_implemented entry carries the reason. The runner gives NOT_IMPLEMENTED to every scenario of a not_implemented module, to every scenario listed under scenarios, and skips every invariant listed under invariants.

INV.reason: The engine has no inventory tables.

DEF.reason: The engine has no deferred-revenue schedule that posts revenue against a contract; amortization_schedules kind deferred_revenue exists but no contract or cancellation model.

FA.reason: The engine has no fixed-asset register.

GL-008.reason: No draft journal entry exists; recordManualJournalEntry posts at once.

GL-012.reason: No reversing-entry operation exists for a posted journal entry.

AR-010.reason: recordPayment refuses an amount above amount_due; no unapplied customer receipt exists.

AR-011.reason: No unapplied customer receipt exists; every payment names an invoice.

AP-009.reason: No vendor prepayment exists; every vendor payment names a bill.

AP-011.reason: No void-bill operation exists for an approved bill.

BANK-009.reason: No statement reconciliation operation exists; only match and reconciliation rules.

BANK-011.reason: No split of one bank transaction across accounts exists.

BANK-012.reason: No split of one bank transaction across customers exists.

FX-009.reason: FX revaluation is report-only; it posts nothing.

FX-010.reason: FX revaluation is report-only; it posts nothing.

FX-011.reason: FX revaluation is report-only; it posts nothing.

FX-012.reason: FX revaluation is report-only; it posts nothing.

ACC-003.reason: recordAccrual posts accrued expenses only; accrued revenue is a documented scope line.

ACC-009.reason: No operation changes an amortization schedule after creation.

ACC-011.reason: No operation cancels an amortization schedule.

ACC-007.reason: postDueAmortizations posts only schedules due by CURRENT_DATE; twelve 2026 recognitions cannot all be posted until 2027. Same clock dependency as ACC-013.

ACC-013.reason: postDueAmortizations reads CURRENT_DATE and takes no as-of date, so 'twice for 2026-01-31' cannot be expressed; the second call posts the next month.

ACC-014.reason: recordAccrual posts the accrual and its reversal in one call; there is no separate reversal run.

CLOSE-005.reason: No reversing-entry operation exists; a January journal cannot be voided.

CLOSE-008.reason: The audit row for a reopen is written by the page action, outside the engine boundary the runner calls.

AUD-009.reason: The audit row for a reopen is written by the page action, outside the engine boundary the runner calls.

AUD-015.reason: Audit rows are written by page actions, outside the engine boundary the runner calls.

NUM-009.reason: A third decimal is refused by FormReader in the page action; the engine casts to numeric(15,2) and would round.

NUM-013.reason: The column-size refusal is answered by the page action's constraint registry, outside the engine boundary.

CON-003.reason: No draft journal entry exists; there is no draft for two users to post.

CON-007.reason: An issued invoice cannot be cancelled; only a draft can be voided, and a draft takes no payment.

RPT-008.reason: No AP aging report exists; apDueSoon lists bills by due date without aging buckets.

RPT-015.reason: No cost-centre report exists; journal_entry_lines.department_id is written by nothing.

RPT-016.reason: No project report over the ledger exists.

RPT-020.reason: The trial balance has no include-zero-balances option.

RPT-023.reason: CSV columns are defined per page action; the engine has no export the runner can call.

FAIL-011.reason: closePeriod writes no audit row; the page action does, outside the engine boundary.

AUD-006.reason: No reversing-entry operation exists; journal_entries carries no reversal link.

INV-JRN-005.reason: No reversing-entry operation exists; journal_entries carries no reversal link column.
